## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

content.text: The workspace is essentially a blank project, so I’m building this as a self-contained, responsive browser game. The core loop will pair a playable Tetris well with a platform-jumping character: each cleared row creates a ledge to climb toward.

<!doctype html>

<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;font-family:Inter,ui-rounded,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0d111b;touch-action:none}body{display:grid;place-items:center;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,#222c41 0%,#101521 62%,#0b0e16 100%)}#game{display:block;width:min(100vw,calc(100dvh * .462));height:min(100dvh,calc(100vw * 2.163));max-width:480px;max-height:1038px;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 24px 80px #0008} @media(max-height:600px) and (orientation:landscape){#game{width:min(100vw,calc(100dvh * .462));height:min(100dvh,calc(100vw * 2.163))}}

<body><canvas id="game" aria-label="Stack Hop game"></canvas>
<script>
(()=>{'use strict';
const canvas=document.getElementById('game'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const W=420,H=910, COLS=10,ROWS=14,CELL=21, BX=25,BY=142, BW=210,BH=294;
const COLORS={I:'#47dce6',O:'#ffd45b',T:'#b18aff',S:'#65e58d',Z:'#ff6f87',J:'#68a1ff',L:'#ff9d5a'};
const SHAPES={I:[[1,1,1,1]],O:[[1,1],[1,1]],T:[[0,1,0],[1,1,1]],S:[[0,1,1],[1,1,0]],Z:[[1,1,0],[0,1,1]],J:[[1,0,0],[1,1,1]],L:[[0,0,1],[1,1,1]]};
let board,piece,nextType,bag=[],dropTimer=0,dropEvery=.7,score=0,lines=0,level=1,gameState='title',last=0,particles=[],camera=0,platforms=[],hero={},keys={},touches={},toast='',toastTime=0,shake=0;
const floorY=0, arena={x:22,y:492,w:376,h:283};
function fit(){let dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2),r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();canvas.width=Math.round(r.width*dpr);canvas.height=Math.round(r.height*dpr);ctx.setTransform(canvas.width/W,0,0,canvas.height/H,0,0)}addEventListener('resize',fit);fit();
function refill(){bag=['I','O','T','S','Z','J','L'].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5)}function drawType(){if(!bag.length)refill();return bag.pop()}
function blankBoard(){return Array.from({length:ROWS},()=>Array(COLS).fill(null))}
function fresh(){board=blankBoard();bag=[];nextType=drawType();score=0;lines=0;level=1;dropEvery=.72;dropTimer=0;platforms=[];camera=0;particles=[];hero={x:104,y:16,vx:0,vy:0,w:18,h:23,onGround:true,ground:-1,face:1};platforms.push({x:22,y:0,w:376,base:true});piece=spawnPiece();gameState='playing';toast='CLEAR LINES. CLIMB HIGHER.';toastTime=2.2}
function spawnPiece(){const t=nextType;nextType=drawType();const m=SHAPES[t].map(r=>r.slice());const p={t,m,x:Math.floor((COLS-m[0].length)/2),y:0};if(collides(p,0,0)){gameState='over'}return p}
function collides(p,dx,dy,m=p.m){for(let y=0;y<m.length;y++)for(let x=0;x<m[y].length;x++)if(m[y][x]){let xx=p.x+x+dx,yy=p.y+y+dy;if(xx<0||xx>=COLS||yy>=ROWS||yy>=0&&board[yy][xx])return true}return false}
function rotate(){if(gameState!=='playing')return;let m=piece.m[0].map((_,i)=>piece.m.map(r=>r[i]).reverse());for(let k of [0,-1,1,-2,2])if(!collides(piece,k,0,m)){piece.x+=k;piece.m=m;return}}
function movePiece(dx){if(gameState==='playing'&&!collides(piece,dx,0))piece.x+=dx}
function merge(){for(let y=0;y<piece.m.length;y++)for(let x=0;x<piece.m[y].length;x++)if(piece.m[y][x]&&piece.y+y>=0)board[piece.y+y][piece.x+x]=COLORS[piece.t];let cleared=0;for(let y=ROWS-1;y>=0;y--)if(board[y].every(Boolean)){board.splice(y,1);board.unshift(Array(COLS).fill(null));cleared++;y++}if(cleared){let points=[0,100,300,500,800][cleared]||1000;score+=points*level;lines+=cleared;level=1+Math.floor(lines/5);dropEvery=Math.max(.12,.72-(level-1)*.055);for(let n=0;n<cleared;n++)makePlatform();toast=cleared===4?'TETRIS! PLATFORM PARTY!':cleared===1?'LINE CLEARED — NEW LEDGE!':`${cleared} LINES! ${cleared} NEW LEDGES!`;toastTime=2.5;shake=.16;burst(130,496,'#f8d869',24)}else score+=1;piece=spawnPiece()}
function hardDrop(){if(gameState!=='playing')return;let n=0;while(!collides(piece,0,1)){piece.y++;n++}score+=n*2;merge();dropTimer=0}
function makePlatform(){let top=platforms.reduce((a,p)=>Math.max(a,p.y),0),y=top+94;let direction=platforms.length%2===0?1:-1;let start=direction>0?34:arena.x+arena.w-214;let width=190+Math.random()*65;platforms.push({x:start,y,w:width,base:false,glow:1});score+=50}
function burst(x,y,color,n){for(let i=0;i<n;i++)particles.push({x,y,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*210,vy:-Math.random()*180,life:.45+Math.random()*.65,color,r:2+Math.random()*3})}
function heroMove(dt){let axis=(keys.ArrowRight||keys.KeyD||touches.right?1:0)-(keys.ArrowLeft||keys.KeyA||touches.left?1:0);hero.vx=axis*155;if(axis)hero.face=axis;hero.x+=hero.vx*dt;hero.x=Math.max(arena.x+hero.w/2,Math.min(arena.x+arena.w-hero.w/2,hero.x));let was=hero.onGround;hero.onGround=false;hero.vy-=510*dt;let oldY=hero.y;hero.y+=hero.vy*dt;
 if(hero.vy<=0){for(let i=platforms.length-1;i>=0;i--){let p=platforms[i];if(hero.x+hero.w*.42>p.x&&hero.x-hero.w*.42<p.x+p.w&&oldY-hero.h/2>=p.y-2&&hero.y-hero.h/2<=p.y){hero.y=p.y+hero.h/2;hero.vy=0;hero.onGround=true;hero.ground=i;break}}}
 if((keys.Space||keys.ArrowUp||keys.KeyW||touches.jump)&&hero.onGround){hero.vy=hero.ground===0?250:310;hero.onGround=false;keys.Space=keys.ArrowUp=keys.KeyW=touches.jump=false;burst(hero.x,screenY(hero.y)-8,'#75edc0',5)}
 camera=Math.max(0,hero.y-118);if(hero.y<Math.max(0,camera-115)){gameState='over'}if(hero.y< -70)gameState='over';
}
function screenY(y){return arena.y+arena.h-18-(y-camera)}
function update(dt){if(gameState!=='playing')return;dropTimer+=dt;if(dropTimer>=dropEvery){dropTimer=0;if(!collides(piece,0,1))piece.y++;else merge()}heroMove(dt);for(let p of platforms)if(p.glow)p.glow=Math.max(0,p.glow-dt);for(let q of particles){q.x+=q.vx*dt;q.y+=q.vy*dt;q.vy+=250*dt;q.life-=dt}particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0);if(toastTime>0)toastTime-=dt;if(shake>0)shake-=dt}
function rounded(x,y,w,h,r,fill,stroke){ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r);if(fill){ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fill()}if(stroke){ctx.strokeStyle=stroke;ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke()}}
function text(s,x,y,size,color,weight='600',align='left'){ctx.font=`${weight} ${size}px ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif`;ctx.textAlign=align;ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fillText(s,x,y)}
function block(x,y,size,color,alpha=1){ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;rounded(x+1,y+1,size-2,size-2,4,color);rounded(x+4,y+3,size-8,3,2,'#ffffff3b');ctx.globalAlpha=1}
function drawBackground(){let g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);g.addColorStop(0,'#1d293b');g.addColorStop(.52,'#172337');g.addColorStop(1,'#111a29');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);for(let i=0;i<38;i++){let x=(i*97+21)%W,y=(i*163+40)%H;ctx.globalAlpha=.16+((i*31)%5)*.045;ctx.fillStyle='#d5efff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,1+(i%3)*.35,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff05';for(let i=0;i<9;i++)ctx.fillRect(i*56-25,90,1,680)}
function drawHeader(){text('STACK',22,37,24,'#f5f8ff','900');text('HOP',105,37,24,'#68e4d0','900');text('A CLEAR IS A CLIMB',22,65,10,'#9babc0','800');rounded(289,17,108,43,13,'#29364a','#45556c');text('BEST',301,29,9,'#9aabc1','800');text(String(Math.max(score,Number(localStorage.getItem('stackhop-best')||0))).padStart(6,'0'),301,47,14,'#fff','800');}
function drawStats(){rounded(25,82,210,41,12,'#202d40','#31445c');text('SCORE',39,96,9,'#93a7bd','800');text(String(score).padStart(6,'0'),39,112,14,'#fff','800');text('LINES',132,96,9,'#93a7bd','800');text(String(lines).padStart(2,'0'),132,112,14,'#fff','800');text('LVL',191,96,9,'#93a7bd','800');text(String(level).padStart(2,'0'),191,112,14,'#ffe184','800');}
function drawBoard(){text('01  /  STACK',25,132,10,'#91a7bd','800');rounded(BX-5,BY-5,BW+10,BH+10,9,'#101a29','#43526a');ctx.fillStyle='#142033';ctx.fillRect(BX,BY,BW,BH);ctx.strokeStyle='#ffffff0b';ctx.lineWidth=1;for(let x=0;x<=COLS;x++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(BX+x*CELL,BY);ctx.lineTo(BX+x*CELL,BY+BH);ctx.stroke()}for(let y=0;y<=ROWS;y++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(BX,BY+y*CELL);ctx.lineTo(BX+BW,BY+y*CELL);ctx.stroke()}
 for(let y=0;y<ROWS;y++)for(let x=0;x<COLS;x++)if(board[y][x])block(BX+x*CELL,BY+y*CELL,CELL,board[y][x]);if(gameState==='playing'&&piece){let ghostY=piece.y;while(!collides(piece,0,ghostY-piece.y+1))ghostY++;for(let y=0;y<piece.m.length;y++)for(let x=0;x<piece.m[y].length;x++)if(piece.m[y][x]){let py=piece.y+y;if(py>=0)block(BX+(piece.x+x)*CELL,BY+py*CELL,CELL,COLORS[piece.t],.38);let gy=ghostY+y;if(gy>=0){ctx.strokeStyle=COLORS[piece.t]+'88';ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(BX+(piece.x+x)*CELL+3,BY+gy*CELL+3,CELL-6,CELL-6,4);ctx.stroke()}}}
 text('NEXT',258,137,10,'#91a7bd','800');rounded(253,151,145,78,12,'#202d40','#31445c');let shape=SHAPES[nextType],cw=18,ox=273+(4-shape[0].length)*8,oy=170+(4-shape.length)*8;for(let y=0;y<shape.length;y++)for(let x=0;x<shape[y].length;x++)if(shape[y][x])block(ox+x*cw,oy+y*cw,cw,COLORS[nextType]);rounded(253,240,145,77,12,'#202d40','#31445c');text('HOW TO',266,257,9,'#93a7bd','800');text('CLEAR LINES',266,277,12,'#fff','800');text('BUILD YOUR WAY UP',266,296,9,'#6fe2d3','700');rounded(253,328,145,78,12,'#253147','#34455f');text('MOVE',266,347,9,'#93a7bd','800');text('←  →',266,371,19,'#fff','800');text('ROTATE',344,347,9,'#93a7bd','800');text('↻',365,375,23,'#ffd56c','800');}
function drawArena(){text('02  /  THE CLIMB',22,470,10,'#91a7bd','800');rounded(arena.x-4,arena.y-4,arena.w+8,arena.h+8,12,'#101b2c','#394e68');ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(arena.x,arena.y,arena.w,arena.h,9);ctx.clip();let bg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,arena.y,0,arena.y+arena.h);bg.addColorStop(0,'#172940');bg.addColorStop(1,'#1a3040');ctx.fillStyle=bg;ctx.fillRect(arena.x,arena.y,arena.w,arena.h);for(let i=0;i<8;i++){let y=((i*51+camera*1.1)%arena.h)+arena.y;ctx.fillStyle='#b9e8ff09';ctx.fillRect(arena.x,y,arena.w,1)}

 let hy=screenY(hero.y);if(hy>arena.y-40&&hy<arena.y+arena.h+35){ctx.save();ctx.translate(hero.x,hy);if(hero.face<0)ctx.scale(-1,1);ctx.shadowColor='#49e8c1';ctx.shadowBlur=12;rounded(-9,-12,18,23,7,'#69e7c2');ctx.shadowBlur=0;rounded(-7,-6,14,9,4,'#effff4');ctx.fillStyle='#25394c';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(-3,-2,1.3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.arc(4,-2,1.3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();rounded(-8,8,7,5,2,'#ffd064');rounded(1,8,7,5,2,'#ffd064');ctx.restore()}

function drawControls(){const y=793;rounded(20,y,104,75,17,'#243146','#3e526a');text('MOVE',72,y+14,9,'#9eb1c5','800','center');button(27,y+26,42,42,'←',touches.left);button(75,y+26,42,42,'→',touches.right);rounded(135,y,112,75,17,'#243146','#3e526a');text('JUMP',191,y+14,9,'#9eb1c5','800','center');button(160,y+26,64,42,'↑',touches.jump,'#3b786f');rounded(258,y,140,75,17,'#243146','#3e526a');text('TETRIS',328,y+14,9,'#9eb1c5','800','center');button(267,y+26,37,42,'◀',touches.leftPiece);button(307,y+26,41,42,'↻',touches.rotate,'#7b6642');button(352,y+26,37,42,'▶',touches.rightPiece);text('DROP',328,884,9,'#91a7bd','800','center')}

Built **STACK HOP** in `index.html` as a complete, responsive browser game. Clear Tetris lines to create ledges, then jump between them to climb. It includes a next-piece preview, scoring and levels, a saved best score, pause/restart, keyboard controls, and touch controls for phones and tablets.

**Controls:** Arrow keys move and rotate Tetris pieces; Enter hard-drops. A/D move the climber; Space jumps. On touchscreens, use the on-screen controls and tap the board to steer pieces.

Verified the game renders in Chromium, checked the portrait layout, and confirmed the JavaScript parses. Screenshot: `screenshots/stackhop.jpg`.

Assumption: each cleared line creates a ledge in the climbing arena.
